name: maybe_Os_SignalAndClose
summary: If the runtime object exists, wakes its waiting thread and sends the close/notify request; a teardown step shared by graphics and sound shutdown paths.
evidence: Callers Gfx_WaitFrameInterval, Gfx_InitializeContext, Svc_RequestWithRetry, Sound_Driver_Shutdown use it as teardown; callees include maybe_Svc_IpcCmd19 and maybe_Snd_SendIpcStatus, but the svc stub is itself only maybe_ named.

name: maybe_Fs_ReadRecordWithRetry
signature: int maybe_Fs_ReadRecordWithRetry(u32 dst, u32* outLen, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Drives a stack provider object through command 0x45, creates a kernel handle, waits on it with svcWaitSynchronization1 and closes it, retrying up to three times and copying the payload to dst.
evidence: Named callee Fs_ReadRecordBlock plus handle helpers (Os_HandleInit, Os_GetCurrentProcessHandle, Os_SignalSemaphore) and svc 0x23/0x24; provider object and vtable unnamed, only caller maybe_Gfx_BlitWorker.

name: maybe_Os_ScanParamBlocks
summary: Fallback scan reading sixteen 0x40-byte blocks from offset 0x400 via Os_ReadChunkedTable, looking for a word with low byte 0xFE, unpacking two 12-bit fields and two payload words into out; returns 0xC8810FEF when nothing matches.
evidence: Uses Os_ReadChunkedTable and maybe_Os_ReleaseSharedHandle; return constant is an SDK error code, but the record owner is unnamed and both callers are guesses.

name: maybe_Container_RbTree_Dtor
summary: Destructor of a container owning a red-black tree plus a fixed 0x21-entry table: destroys the table, erases every tree node via successor helpers, unlinks the object from its sibling list and frees it.
evidence: Callees std_RbTree_EraseNode, std__Rb_tree_rebalance, std_destroy_range and Pack_ReleaseHandle confirm a std::map/std::set member, but the owning class is unnamed and there are no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_Object_Dtor
summary: Destructor of a small object owning one smart handle: installs its vtable, releases the handle at +0x10 with the handle-table validity test, unlinks the node and frees the block.
evidence: Body calls Pack_ReleaseHandle and Pack_ReleaseHandleEntry and installs g_uiObjectBaseVtable, but the vtable is still only maybe_ named and there are no callers.

name: maybe_Pack_ReleaseMemberHandles4
summary: Releases the four generation-tagged handle members at +4, +0xC, +0x14 and +0x1C of the object whose base is self-0x1C, then returns that base.
evidence: Four sibling Pack_ReleaseHandle calls at 8-byte strides returning self-4; only caller Container_HashMap_Init does not name the class.

name: maybe_Pack_ReleaseMemberHandles1
summary: Releases the single generation-tagged handle member at +4 of the object whose base is self-4 and returns that base; the one-handle variant of 0x00120408.
evidence: Single Pack_ReleaseHandle call returning self-4; no callers and no class name.

name: maybe_Ui_DetachAndReleaseMembers
signature: int maybe_Ui_DetachAndReleaseMembers(void* self, u32 value, DetachTarget* target)
summary: Stores value into target+8 then releases the three generation-tagged handle members at self+4, +0xC and +0x14, returning self; called from UI layout code.
evidence: Three sibling Pack_ReleaseHandle calls at 8-byte strides; callers Ui_Layout_UpdateScreenBuffers and maybe_Ui_MapWindow_ResolveTouchTarget are UI, but the detach semantics are inferred from the target+8 store.

name: maybe_Pack_ReleaseMemberHandles2
summary: Releases two generation-tagged handles at self-8 and self-4 via Pack_ReleaseHandle and returns the base self-0xC; only reached through a data pointer, so the exact owner type is unknown.
evidence: Body calls Pack_ReleaseHandle twice on self-8 and self-4 and returns self-0xC; no callers, no strings, no vtable neighbours.

name: Event_ActivateFlagAndClearSlot
summary: Sets quest/event flag id to state 2 in the id set and, when the data-manager record for that id has type 3 or 8, clears the associated bag slot through the save work vtable+8.
evidence: Calls Event_UpdateIdSet(idSet,id,2), then Game_GetDataManager/func_0063D338 record type check at +8 and invokes (work+0x24A98)->vt[+8] with the u16 at record+0xA; caller is maybe_Event_SetFlagState.

name: Event_UnlockFlag39IfProgress
signature: void Event_UnlockFlag39IfProgress(void* idSet, u32 learnedId, u32 arg3, u32 context)
summary: Sets quest/event flag 0x39 to state 1 when it is unset, the learned id is 0x1AB, the bag word at +0x31C4 is not 0x278 and the bag byte 0x1E is above 10; called from Party_Member_LearnSkillOrSpell.
evidence: Reads flag 0x39 via func_0066AF08, checks learnedId==0x1AB, bag word +0x31C4 != 0x278, func_0066B17C(bag,0x1E)>10, then Event_UpdateIdSet(idSet,0x39,1); caller Party_Member_LearnSkillOrSpell.

name: Event_UnlockFlag39IfMemberHasId
signature: void Event_UnlockFlag39IfMemberHasId(void* idSet, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 context)
summary: Sets quest/event flag 0x39 to state 1 when it is unset and party member 7 carries id 0x1AB in its id list; only caller is the script native CheckSkillPanelOpenedQ590.
evidence: Checks flag 0x39 via func_0066AF08, gets member 7 via func_0035EB98(work,7), tests func_00629988(member,0x1AB), then Event_UpdateIdSet(idSet,0x39,1); caller CheckSkillPanelOpenedQ590.

name: Event_SetFlagState
summary: Sets quest/event flag flagId to state on the id set at work+8->+0x90; state 2 takes the special path that also clears the associated bag slot.
evidence: Non-2 path calls Event_UpdateIdSet(*(work+8)+0x90, flagId, state); state 2 path calls maybe_Event_ActivateFlagAndClearSlot with the same id set.

name: maybe_Event_AdvanceFlagState7To8
signature: void maybe_Event_AdvanceFlagState7To8(void* idSet, u32 flagId, int arg3, int context)
summary: When quest/event flag flagId is in state 7, moves it to state 8 through Event_UpdateIdSet; called from field and UI code that do not name the flag.
evidence: Reads flag state via func_0066AF08(work+0x24A98, flagId) and calls Event_UpdateIdSet(idSet,flagId,8) only when it equals 7; callers Field_InitSceneObjects and maybe_Ui_ListEntry_SyncSprite.

name: maybe_std_String_AppendRange
signature: void maybe_std_String_AppendRange(std_String* str, const char* end)
summary: Out-of-line std::string growth/append path that either overwrites in place or grows and copies the byte range; used by Event_UpdateIdSet's sorted id vector and Text_LayoutColumns.
evidence: Body manipulates the begin/end/capacity triple and calls std_memmove; callers Event_UpdateIdSet and Text_LayoutColumns; decompilation damaged (std_memmove mis-marked noreturn).

name: maybe_Data_BuildTaggedRecord44
signature: void maybe_Data_BuildTaggedRecord44(u32* out, u32 first, u32 second)
summary: Builds a 0x44-byte tagged record by formatting through 0x006F0C10 with a global descriptor and copying the 17-word result into out behind a type-descriptor word; used by battle model-resource binding routines.
evidence: Calls func_006F0C10 with global 0x0072D74C+4 and the two args, copies 17 words into out and overwrites out[0] with a descriptor; callers are BattleScene_BindUnitModelResources, Battle_Ui_LoadPartyModelResources, BattleScene_SyncUnitRenderResources.

name: maybe_Save_IncrementCounter
summary: Increments a per-index u32 counter at (work+0x24A98)+0x2998+index*4 unless event-mode bit 0x80 is set and the current map id is below 0xE; called from casino slot/jackpot screens and party-panel helpers.
evidence: Callers are casino/UI code (Ui_JackpotScreen_EndPayout, Casino_Slot_CalcPatternPayout, Casino_Slot_StopReel); callees Game_GetWork, Spirit_CountRosterEntries, Field_LevelMap_AddCell_Part3; the counter semantics are not confirmed by any named callee.

name: Battle_DetachCurrentActor
summary: Calls the current battle actor's vtable+0x28 teardown slot and hides the battle target window at battleWork+0x431C; called at the start of BattleScene_AttachPrimaryUnitModels to detach the previous actor presentation.
evidence: Only caller is named BattleScene_AttachPrimaryUnitModels; callees Ui_BattleTargetWindow_Hide and Os_GetGameWork; reads battleWork+0x4320 current actor and +0x431C target window.

name: maybe_Battle_ClearActionSlots
summary: Resets four 0x58-byte slot records at self+0x150 (zeroing id/flag words and clearing the 0x38-byte tail) then refills one slot per active party member via Battle_Monster_UpdateConditionSlots.
evidence: Caller Battle_FinishCommandPhase; callee Battle_Monster_UpdateConditionSlots; whether the records are command slots or unit-condition slots is still open.

name: Ui_ShopWindow_DtorBody
summary: Complete-object (D1) destructor body of the shop window: reinstalls sub-object tables, re-links list sentinels, tears down the embedded gold window, two-column list, three-row text and item rows, and finishes with the base destructor.
evidence: Callees are exactly the shop window's parts: Ui_GoldWindow_Dtor, Ui_TwoColumnListWindow_Dtor, Ui_ThreeRowNullTextWindow_Dtor, Ui_ItemMenu_Row_Dtor, plus Ui_Object_DtorBase.

name: maybe_Field_DestroyNpcActionObject
summary: Deleting destructor of a large field widget object: releases the child at +0x324, destroys the embedded message page and a chain of embedded sub-objects, then frees the block.
evidence: No named context identifies the concrete class; vtable 0x007584E8 lists generic scene/widget virtuals; mechanism (message page + child + free) confirmed but class not.

name: maybe_Ui_MovieWindow_Dtor
summary: Deleting destructor of the movie window: reinstalls class table 0x00758C0C, releases three layout references, destroys the embedded object chain and base object, then frees the window.
evidence: Class block is coherent (maybe_Ui_MovieWindow_InitBase 0x001CE8AC and maybe_Ui_MovieWindow_UpdateLayout 0x001CE658 end 0xB0 bytes before this dtor) but every name in the block is still maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_DungeonPlaceWindow_Dtor
summary: Deleting destructor releasing seven 0x50-byte layout parts and the node member, running the base destructor and freeing the window.
evidence: 14-entry caller list is misleading: 13 callers tail-jump into the shared tail at 0x001CF7F4 (mid-function split), so this is not a shared helper; class only placed by its block (maybe_Ui_DungeonPlaceWindow_CreateBase 0x001CF72C).

name: maybe_Ui_SingleLayoutObject_Dtor
summary: Small deleting destructor: releases the one embedded layout arena at +0x4C, runs the base destructor and frees the object; body identical to maybe_Ui_WidgetWithSubObject_DeletingDtor (0x002BD834), a template copy.
evidence: Body byte-identical to the ctor pair at 0x002BD834/0x002BD858; no caller, constructor or vtable slot names it, so the class cannot be inferred from shape.

name: maybe_Ui_ThreeLayoutWindow_Dtor
summary: Deleting destructor that releases three layout references at 0x50 stride and runs the base object destructor; the concrete window class is still unidentified.
evidence: Only callees are Ui_LayoutRef_Release and Ui_Object_DtorBase; no named constructor or caller ties it to a class.

name: maybe_Ui_TwoLayoutWindow_Dtor
summary: Deleting destructor releasing two layout references and the base object; class attribution unsupported.
evidence: Same 0x50-stride release pattern as 0x0021FD38; no constructor or named caller identifies the class.

name: maybe_Ui_CreditWindow_Dtor
summary: Deleting destructor of a composite window: reinstalls the class vtable, releases a layout ref, tears down embedded list nodes and the base object, then frees.
evidence: Sits between Ui_CreditWindow_Create and maybe_Ui_CreditWindow_ReleaseAnimations; body uses g_uiCompositeWindowVtable and Ui_LayoutRef_Release/Ui_Object_DtorBase.

name: maybe_Ui_CreditWindow_DeletingDtor
summary: Large deleting destructor releasing a long chain of layout references and embedded object bases before freeing; exact class unknown.
evidence: Only Ui_LayoutRef_Release and Ui_Object_DtorBase callees; no constructor builds this eight-arena layout.

name: Ui_SmithMenu_DetailWindow_Dtor
summary: Deleting destructor of the smith menu detail window: destroys the two 0x50-byte sub-objects at +0x4C, runs the base destructor and frees.
evidence: All four callers are named smith-menu functions (Ui_SmithMenu_DetailOpen, Ui_SmithMenu_UpdateCategory, SelectCategoryPower/Detail) that replace the detail pane on category change.

name: maybe_Ui_ObjectDestroyThunk2
summary: Shared destroy-and-free tail: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase then the free helper; used by unrelated classes so it is not one class's destructor.
evidence: Six callers from unrelated subsystems (sprite actor, marker, field grid, layout group, trail, pane scroll rect).

name: maybe_Ui_Object_DtorWithListHeads
summary: Destructor body of a UI object owning three intrusive circular lists: reinstalls class vtables, empties the list sentinels, then runs the base destructor and node-list unregister.
evidence: No named constructor identifies the concrete class; only the list-head teardown shape is visible.

name: maybe_Ui_Window_IconTableDtor
summary: Deleting destructor trampoline of an embedded window sub-object: stores the vtable, releases the handle pair at +0x124, runs the base destructor on the enclosing object and frees.
evidence: Only callers are maybe_Ui_ItemInfoWindow_ChildWindow_Dtor/DeletingDtor; the IconTable label comes only from the neighbouring constructor.

name: maybe_Ui_Window_IconTableDtorBase

evidence: Identical first half to 0x002BB758 and tail branch to named Ui_Object_DtorBase; 53 callers are generic UI ctors/dtors, no named caller fixes the sub-object class.

name: maybe_Menu_ItemBox_Destruct
summary: Deleting destructor of a small menu object (vtable 0x00762760 slot 1): runs Ui_Object_DtorBase then frees.
evidence: Vtable 0x00762760 slot 0 = 0x002FCC74, slot 1 = this; class slots are generic Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim and shared bind helper, so the 'item box' owner is not confirmed; only caller Ui_SkillPanel_Dtor.

name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_Dtor_62D68

evidence: Vtable 0x00762D68 slot 0 is this; +0x1C is Ui_ListWindow_SetupTextRows and +0x3C Ui_TextWidget_MoveCursorBy, confirming list-window responsibility but not the concrete class; no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_ScrollListWindow_DeleteSubObject
summary: Deleting destructor of a scroll-list sub-object: destroys the UI base, unlinks list heads and frees the storage.
evidence: Paired with maybe_Ui_ScrollListWindow_CreateSubObject (0x003B7F54) which creates the object 0x64 bytes earlier; both names remain maybe_ and no vtable member names the class.

name: maybe_Ui_TsuyosaWindow_DeleteRow
summary: Deleting destructor of one tsuyosa (strength) row object: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees.
evidence: Vtable 0x00768F14 slot 0 is this; +0x1C is maybe_Ui_TsuyosaWindow_UpdateRowText and +0x3C maybe_Ui_ListGrid_MoveCursor, but the row updater is itself below 0.5.

name: maybe_Ui_Object_DtorGarbled
summary: Eight-byte thumb entry inside a jump table; body unrecoverable (unaff_r9/in_OV/coprocessor pseudo-code) and no vtable slot points at it.
evidence: No vtable slot in [addr-0x40, addr+0x40]; recovered body is unaff_*/in_OV/coprocessor pseudo-code, so per the Ghidra-damage rule it stays maybe_ at 0.30.

name: maybe_Ui_EmbeddedObject_Dtor
summary: Deleting destructor of a message-window sub-object embedding a UI object at +0x120: destroys the embedded object and its prefix, then frees.
evidence: Vtable 0x0076FFDC slot 0 holds 0x00446FFC four bytes before this entry; table methods include maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_RebuildRows and Ui_Serialize_ReadOptionalObjectRef, tying it to the message window but not naming the concrete class.

name: maybe_Ui_Widget_DtorVirtual_53C8
summary: Deleting destructor (slot 1) of the small child widget built by maybe_Ui_Widget_Ctor_53A8: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees.
evidence: Vtable 0x00771F70 = [0x004653D8 non-deleting, this deleting]; +0x1C Ui_PartyIconRow_SetVisible and +0x20 Ui_FourRowTextWindow_InitPanesD mix two class names, and the ctor is still maybe_.

name: Ui_TextList_DeleteViaVtable
summary: Multiple-inheritance deleting destructor for the text-list class: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and dispatches the secondary base's delete through the vtable word at (object-8)+4.
evidence: vtable 0x00775740 slot 0 is this function; +0x1C is maybe_Ui_TextList_ClearRows; body is the generic MI virtual-delete dispatch idiom calling Ui_Object_DtorBase.

name: maybe_Ui_Widget_Dtor_7760E8
summary: Deleting destructor (slot 1) of a bare UI-object subclass: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees; the vtable has no class override so the widget stays unnamed.
evidence: vtable 0x007760E8 = [0x004ADB5C non-deleting, this]; +0x1C is shared Ui bind helper 0x001A6520; ctor installs same table; body calls Ui_Object_DtorBase then free.

name: maybe_Ui_MemberOrderWindow_DtorB
summary: Deleting destructor (slot 1) of the eight-slot member-order window: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees.
evidence: vtable 0x00778AF4 = [0x004CF57C non-deleting, this]; +0x1C/+0x20 generic visibility/bind pair; maybe_Ui_MemberOrderWindow_Ctor (0x004CF548) installs 0x00778AF4; body calls Ui_Object_DtorBase then free.

name: Ui_CasinoSlotWindow_Dtor_vt779C7C

evidence: vtable 0x00779C7C = [0x004D4F48 non-deleting, this]; +0x20 is Ui_Window_PlayLoopPaneAnim; caller is Casino_Slot_Dtor giving casino context; body calls Ui_Object_DtorBase then free.

summary: Deleting destructor of the plain backdrop-window class at vtable 0x0077FE68; its only class-specific virtual is Ui_Window_CreateBlackPane.
evidence: vtable 0x0077FE68: word 0 is this function, words 1-6 shared UiWindow base methods, word 7 is 0x0061A3FC Ui_Window_CreateBlackPane; body calls Ui_Object_DtorBase then free.

name: maybe_Ui_Widget_DrawPass_Dtor
summary: Deleting destructor of the render-widget class in the casino-slot module whose vtable replaces three base draw passes with Ui_Widget_DrawPass4/5/6.
evidence: vtable 0x0076202C: word 0 is this function, words 2-4 are 0x006E2018/0x006E2118/0x006E2234 (Ui_Widget_DrawPass4/5/6), word 7 base init 0x001A6520; concrete class unidentified.

name: Field_NpcFinishAction
summary: Field-scene-node virtual that ends an NPC action: for state bytes 1/2 resolves the node's action slot through the game work and removes the node from the owner's handle slots, then releases the node's effect slots.
evidence: Slot of vtable 0x007585DC in field-scene-node family; callers Field_CreateActorFromId and maybe_Field_NpcAction_NotifyChildrenState; callees Actor_RemoveHandleFromSlots, Field_SceneObject_ReleaseEffectSlots, Os_GetGameWork.

name: maybe_Script_SqValueList_Dtor
summary: Destructor of a refcounted value-array holder: installs vtable 0x007589F4, unlinks from owner, releases the refcounted block at +0x1C, resets 8-byte elements to the shared null value, then destroys the element array via std_destroy_range and installs the base vtable 0x0075A728.
evidence: Body is damaged decompilation (unaff_r7, flag registers) so confidence kept at 0.3; the structure (vtable 0x007589F4, refcount decrement at +4, std_destroy_range with 0x001BF798, base vtable 0x0075A728) matches a refcounted value-list destructor, and neighbours are Script_SqValueList_Ctor/CtorB, supporting the Script_SqValueList_Dtor guess.

name: maybe_Party_ShiftRecordSlots
summary: Inserts a 0x44-byte record into the five-slot array at +0x92F4, shifting/appending; the shift count is a damaged magic-multiply division and the wcslen call is mis-marked noreturn, so the exact slot logic is unclear.
evidence: Only caller is PartyStatus_LoadNewestRecord; stride 0x44 and range +0x92F4..+0x9448 visible, but shift count recovered as nonsense 0x78787879 and 0x00100B74 (wcslen) mis-marked noreturn.
